appliedLineageOnly.description: Replaying only the 71 applied migrations. Does NOT match production: the repository lineage is missing every out-of-band change and carries a duplicate status trigger the lineage never drops.

trigger_flag_status_change present -> DOUBLE points per status change

acceptedResidualDeltas.reason: Data snapshots created out of band by nonmanaged/destructive-data/2026-08-22_takedown_junk_flags_APPLIED.sql, which the replay harness refuses to execute. They are not part of the application contract, hold no FK to users or flags, and Phase 05 may remove them outright (they are unreachable by any deletion path). Recreating them in a rebuilt database would prejudge that privacy decision.

environmentCaveats: Replay Postgres is 17.11; production is 17.6.1. Same major version; no schema-affecting difference observed.

pg_net is a signature-compatible stub (supabase/replay/stub-extensions/) performing no network I/O. auth.uid()/auth.email()/auth.role() read GUCs instead of a JWT. vault.decrypted_secrets is an empty view. The replay therefore proves SCHEMA reproduction, not runtime behaviour of those stubbed pieces.
uuid-ossp and pgcrypto are real, not stubbed.
